feed.title: Google Cloud: Sovereign Controls by Partners
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Sovereign Controls by Partners

entry.content:
The France Data Boundary by S3NS supports the following products:

  • AlloyDB for PostgreSQL
  • Apigee
  • Eventarc
entry.summary: Introducing the France Data Boundary by S3NS, enhancing data residency for AlloyDB for PostgreSQL, Apigee, and Eventarc. This feature ensures data stays within French borders, providing greater control and compliance.
entry.title: Feature: New Data Boundary for France

entry.content:
The Italy Data Boundary by PSN supports the following products:

entry.summary: A new data boundary for Italy is now available. This feature supports AlloyDB for PostgreSQL, Apigee, and Eventarc, enhancing data sovereignty options for users in Italy.
entry.title: Feature: New Data Boundary for Italy

entry.content:

entry.title: Feature: New data boundary options in Germany
